audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-006: Receipt bloom must be computed from transaction logs via logs_bloom
audit_items.rationale: Receipt bloom computation (logs_bloom / make_receipt / SG-007) is an execution-layer concept defined in the Osaka execution spec. Prysm is a consensus-layer (CL) client that only stores LogsBloom as an opaque field received from the execution engine via Engine API. No bloom filter computation or validation logic exists in the Prysm codebase. The CL trusts the EL for this computation.

code_scope.reason: EL execution spec concept not implemented in Prysm CL client

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-001: Every error path in transaction validation must terminate by raising an InvalidTransaction subclass
audit_items.rationale: Transaction validation error handling (InvalidTransaction exceptions / SG-004) is an execution-layer concept from the Osaka execution spec. Prysm is a CL client that delegates transaction validation entirely to the execution engine. No InvalidTransaction exception classes or transaction validation error paths exist in Prysm. Transaction validity is determined by the EL and communicated via Engine API status codes.

code_scope.reason: EL execution spec concept not implemented in Prysm CL client

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-001: A transaction is valid if and only if it passes all applicable checks
audit_items.rationale: Transaction validity completeness (SG-004) is an execution-layer concept. Prysm CL client does not implement transaction validation logic. All transaction checking is delegated to the execution engine via the Engine API. The CL only receives execution payloads containing already-validated transactions.

code_scope.reason: EL execution spec concept not implemented in Prysm CL client

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-008: Blob data presence must be checked before count validation
audit_items.rationale: Blob transaction validation ordering (blob_transaction_validation / SG-005) is an execution-layer concept. Prysm implements blob *sidecar* gossip validation (validate_blob.go) but NOT blob *transaction* validation which checks data presence before count. The EL is responsible for validating blob transactions including data presence, count limits, and versioned hashes. Prysm only validates blob sidecars at the gossip level for consensus purposes.

code_scope.reason: EL blob_transaction_validation not implemented in Prysm CL client. Prysm only has CL blob sidecar gossip validation.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-008: Blob gas limit must be checked before fee sufficiency
audit_items.rationale: Blob gas limit validation ordering within blob_transaction_validation (SG-005) is an execution-layer concept. Prysm CL client does not implement blob gas limit checking or fee sufficiency validation. These are EL transaction pool and execution responsibilities. No blob gas limit or fee validation code exists in Prysm.

code_scope.reason: EL blob gas/fee validation not implemented in Prysm CL client

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-008: Blob validation must fail on the first invalid versioned hash (short-circuit)
audit_items.rationale: Versioned hash short-circuit validation in blob_transaction_validation (SG-005) is an execution-layer concept. Prysm CL validates blob sidecar KZG commitments at the gossip level but does not validate versioned hashes against transaction data. This is the responsibility of the execution engine.

code_scope.reason: EL versioned hash validation not implemented in Prysm CL client

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-001: Integer arithmetic in fee calculations must not overflow
audit_items.rationale: Integer overflow in effective_gas_price fee calculations (SG-013) is an execution-layer concept. Prysm CL client does not implement any fee calculation arithmetic. BaseFeePerGas is stored as an opaque 32-byte value received from the execution engine. No arithmetic operations on fee values exist in the Prysm consensus layer.

code_scope.reason: EL fee arithmetic not implemented in Prysm CL client

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-010: Blocks just under MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE with maximally complex transactions must not cause disproportionate processing
audit_items.rationale: MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE enforcement and RLP block size DoS protection (SG-003) are execution-layer concepts from EIP-7934. Prysm CL client uses SSZ encoding for beacon blocks, not RLP. The CL does not enforce RLP block size limits. Execution payload size limits are the responsibility of the execution engine. Prysm only validates SSZ-encoded beacon block sizes.

code_scope.reason: EL RLP block size limits not implemented in Prysm CL client (uses SSZ)

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-001: Format string values in exception messages must not be vulnerable to injection
audit_items.rationale: Format string injection in InvalidTransaction exception classes (SG-001) is an execution-layer concept from the Osaka execution spec (Python reference). Prysm is a Go-based CL client that does not define or use these exception classes. Go's fmt package is not vulnerable to the same format string attacks as Python. No EL exception formatting code exists in Prysm.

code_scope.reason: EL exception classes not implemented in Prysm CL client

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-012: Base fee calculation must use ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER = 2
audit_items.rationale: ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER and EIP-1559 base fee calculation (calculate_base_fee_per_gas / SG-004) are execution-layer concepts. Prysm CL client does not implement base fee calculation. The ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER constant is not defined anywhere in the Prysm codebase. Base fee computation is entirely the responsibility of the execution engine.

code_scope.reason: EL base fee calculation not implemented in Prysm CL client

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-012: Gas limit must pass check_gas_limit validation within calculate_base_fee_per_gas
audit_items.rationale: Gas limit validation within base fee calculation (check_gas_limit / SG-004) is an execution-layer concept. Prysm CL client stores GasLimit as a uint64 from execution payloads but does not validate gas limit bounds or perform check_gas_limit validation. This is entirely an EL responsibility.

code_scope.reason: EL gas limit validation not implemented in Prysm CL client

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-012: Base fee maximum change rate must be bounded by parent_base_fee // BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR
audit_items.rationale: BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR and base fee change rate bounding (SG-004) are execution-layer EIP-1559 concepts. Prysm CL client does not implement base fee change rate calculations. The constant is not defined in the Prysm codebase. This is entirely an EL responsibility.

code_scope.reason: EL base fee change denominator not implemented in Prysm CL client

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-001: The P256VERIFY precompile MUST NOT revert for any input
audit_items.rationale: P256VERIFY precompile (EIP-7951, address 0x100) is an execution-layer EVM precompile. Prysm is a consensus-layer client that does not implement EVM precompiles. Comprehensive search found no P256, secp256r1, or precompile registry code in the Prysm codebase. The only curve implementations are secp256k1 (for P2P) and BLS (for consensus). EVM precompile implementation is the responsibility of EL clients (Geth, Reth, Nethermind, etc.).

code_scope.reason: EVM precompile not implemented in Prysm CL client

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-003: The P256VERIFY precompile MUST return exactly 32 bytes containing the value 1
audit_items.rationale: P256VERIFY return value format (EIP-7951 SG-001) is an EVM precompile behavior. Prysm CL client does not implement EVM precompiles. No P256VERIFY or secp256r1 code exists in the Prysm codebase.

code_scope.reason: EVM precompile not implemented in Prysm CL client

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-002: The P256VERIFY precompile MUST charge exactly 6900 gas
audit_items.rationale: P256VERIFY gas pricing (EIP-7951 SG-006, 6900 gas) is an EVM precompile concept. Prysm CL client does not implement EVM gas metering or precompile pricing. No precompile gas cost definitions exist in the Prysm codebase.

code_scope.reason: EVM precompile gas pricing not implemented in Prysm CL client

audit_items.title: Verify Invariant: The secp256r1 curve parameters must be hardcoded correctly
audit_items.rationale: secp256r1 curve parameter constants (EIP-7951 SG-003) are part of the P256VERIFY EVM precompile implementation. Prysm CL client does not use or define secp256r1 parameters. The only elliptic curves used in Prysm are secp256k1 (P2P networking) and BLS12-381 (consensus signatures). No NIST P-256 curve constants exist in the codebase.

code_scope.reason: secp256r1 curve not used in Prysm CL client

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-001: Input validation MUST be performed in the specified sequential order
audit_items.rationale: P256VERIFY input validation ordering (EIP-7951 SG-002: length check -> range checks -> curve point validation) is an EVM precompile concept. Prysm CL client does not implement this precompile or any secp256r1 input validation logic.

code_scope.reason: EVM precompile input validation not implemented in Prysm CL client

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-001: The signature component r MUST satisfy 0 < r < n
audit_items.rationale: P256VERIFY r range validation (EIP-7951 SG-002, 0 < r < n for secp256r1 subgroup order) is an EVM precompile concept. Prysm CL client does not implement secp256r1 signature validation. The secp256k1 code in Prysm is for P2P networking and uses a different curve.

code_scope.reason: secp256r1 signature validation not implemented in Prysm CL client

audit_items.rationale: P256VERIFY s range validation (EIP-7951 SG-002, 0 < s < n for secp256r1 subgroup order) is an EVM precompile concept. Prysm CL client does not implement secp256r1 signature validation.

audit_items.rationale: P256VERIFY qx field modulus validation (EIP-7951 SG-002, 0 <= qx < p for secp256r1 field) is an EVM precompile concept. Prysm CL client does not implement secp256r1 public key validation.
